welcomeModal.title: Welcome to CVI Book Builder
welcomeModal.leadHtml: Build CVI-friendly story books as a letter-sized landscape PowerPoint (and optional PDF via print). Odd pages use high-contrast accessible text and your images; even pages carry the story, salient features, and optional teaching activities. Everything runs in your browser—your book content stays on this device until you export, print, or share it yourself.

features.bookSetup: Book Setup & presets — Title, ECC area, activity prompt, text position, visual complexity, and one-click high-contrast palettes.
features.aiWorkflow: AI-assisted workflow — Copy the formatting prompt, paste the model’s tagged reply, then parse into spreads; edit any field by hand.
features.imageIsolator: Image Isolator — Wikimedia search, background removal, outlines; up to four odd-page images per spread; HEIC from iPhones converts here.
features.digitizeBook: Digitize Book — Choose Normal book (PDF, EPUB, or photos + OCR) or CVI Book Nook (auto-import a Ready-to-Print PDF).
features.livePreview: Live preview — Matches export layout; refresh if the preview ever looks stale.
features.tviNotes: TVI Session Notes — Student tips plus Copy FVA/LMA Summary for reports.
features.drafts: Drafts — Save and reload work in this browser (export .pptx as a backup for important books).

welcomeModal.qs1: Set Book Setup at the top (title, ECC, activity prompt, layout options).

getHelpModal.title: Get help
getHelpModal.aboutHtml: CVI Book Builder helps teachers and families create CVI-friendly story books for children with cortical visual impairment. You can build a letter-sized landscape PowerPoint with high-contrast picture pages, story text on story pages, salient feature notes, optional activity ideas, and a live preview. The tool runs entirely in your browser; your book text and images stay on your device unless you choose to export.
getHelpModal.licenseHtml: CVI Book Builder (this app’s own code) is provided under the MIT License. Third-party libraries loaded in the browser (for example HEIC photo conversion and PowerPoint export) may use other licenses such as MIT or LGPL-3.0. If you use the project from its GitHub repository, see the README and LICENSE files there for full attribution and license texts.

userGuideModal.title: User guide
userGuideModal.leadHint: Step-by-step workflow for building a CVI-friendly book, from setup through export. Everything runs in your browser; drafts and exports stay on your device unless you share them elsewhere.
userGuideModal.overviewHtml: CVI Book Builder creates a letter-sized landscape PowerPoint with a consistent CVI-friendly layout: picture pages (odd slides) show high-contrast accessible text and your images, and story pages (even slides) carry the story text (rotated for binding), salient features, and optional teaching activities. A live preview mirrors the same rules as download.
userGuideModal.wf1: Start — Choose Write with AI, Digitize a book, Import CVI Book Nook, or Start blank. Returning users can continue a draft. Set the book title early so drafts can auto-save.
userGuideModal.wf2: Optional: Open Style for a Quick Preset or picture-page colors, sizes, and borders. Open Book details for ECC area, activity prompt, picture-page text position, and teaching activities.
userGuideModal.wf3: Story content — Use Copy AI Formatting Prompt, paste the assistant’s reply, then Parse Into Spreads; add spreads by hand; or use Digitize to import a PDF, EPUB, photos, or a CVI Book Nook print PDF.
userGuideModal.wf4: Images — Open Images for the Isolator (upload, Wikimedia, background removal, outline), use Prepare image on a spread, or attach files directly (up to four picture-page images). HEIC from iPhones is converted in the browser.
userGuideModal.wf5: Spreads — Refine story text, the accessible keyword, and photos first. More on this spread holds salient features and the image prompt. Use Add Spread or Remove as needed.
userGuideModal.wf6: Review — Watch the Live Preview update as you edit; use Refresh Preview if something looks stale.
userGuideModal.wf7: Documentation — Fill in TVI Session Notes and Copy FVA/LMA Summary when you need text for reports.
userGuideModal.wf8: Finish — Download PowerPoint (.pptx). Use Drafts to save and restore work in this browser.
userGuideModal.bookSetupHtml: Book title and ECC Area (Expanded Core Curriculum) appear in the deck where the template expects them. Activity Prompt feeds optional sensory or classroom activity ideas. Picture page text position moves the large accessible label (top, bottom, left, or right). Visual complexity is in Style and adjusts how busy slides feel. Toggle Include Teaching Activities to show or hide the teaching-activities block on story pages.
userGuideModal.presetsHtml: Quick Presets apply common high-contrast palettes (for example yellow/black or red/black) in one click. Fine-tune picture-page text and border colors and sizes, picture-page background, and story text color. Open Style from the workspace whenever you need these controls.
userGuideModal.storyHtml: Click Copy AI Formatting Prompt and paste it into your AI tool. The model returns text using the TITLE, ECC_AREA, ACTIVITY_PROMPT, and SPREAD blocks shown in the placeholder. Paste that output into AI formatted text, then click Parse Into Spreads to fill or update your spreads. You can still edit every field manually afterward. Each spread can include a separate image prompt for external image generators; use Copy image prompt on a spread when needed.
userGuideModal.digitizeHtml: Choose a book type first. Normal book (default): upload a PDF, EPUB, or page photos. EPUB text is extracted from the file (you can still run OCR). For PDF and photos, click Run OCR on all pages to extract text with PaddleOCR (models download once in your browser). Edit the page text to fix mistakes. Drag a box around a character or object, then Crop & remove background (uses the Image Isolator outline settings). Optionally Copy all pages for AI review, paste the tagged reply, and apply—isolated crops stay on matching pages. When ready, Build book from pages creates one spread per page with the corrected text and isolated crops. DRM-encrypted EPUBs cannot be opened. Reflowable EPUBs use one page per chapter file. CVI Book Nook: upload a Ready-to-Print PDF from cvibooks.com. The app reads the cover title, pairs each story page (Salient Features:) with the following photo page, and builds spreads automatically—no OCR.
userGuideModal.imagesHtml: Upload a photo or search Wikimedia Commons, then run Remove Background. Optionally enable Add object outline and set color and thickness for extra separation on busy backgrounds. Download Result saves the processed image so you can attach it on a spread. This is optional if you already have cut-out or simple images.
userGuideModal.spreadsHtml: Each spread becomes two slides: a picture page (accessible keyword and images) and a story page (story text, rotated for binding). Edit Story text and the Accessible keyword first; Salient features and the image prompt sit under More on this spread. Add one to four images on the picture page. Parse Into Spreads replaces all current spreads with the spreads from your pasted text. If the text includes TITLE, ECC_AREA, or ACTIVITY_PROMPT, those lines also update Book details when present.
userGuideModal.previewExportHtml: The Live Preview uses the same layout logic as export. Refresh Preview forces a full redraw. Download PowerPoint (.pptx) builds the file with PptxGenJS; large decks may take a moment (a progress overlay can appear).
userGuideModal.tviHtml: Use Student-specific CVI tips for ongoing recommendations. Copy FVA/LMA Summary copies formatted text you can paste into evaluation or report documents.
userGuideModal.draftsHtml: Open Drafts to save snapshots of your book in this browser. Storage is local only; clearing site data or using another device removes access. Save important work as PowerPoint as a backup, especially for large books with many images.
userGuideModal.creditsFooterHtml: For contact, third-party library attribution (including LGPL-3.0 HEIC conversion), and full license texts, use Get help.

digitize.aiReviewTemplate:
Output your response using EXACTLY these tags. Do not add any other formatting or commentary.

TITLE: [Book title]

ECC_AREA: [ECC area focus, e.g., Compensatory Access, Self-Determination]

ACTIVITY_PROMPT: [One-sentence sensory activity suggestion, e.g., Create a feely box with a ball and a dog toy.]

SPREAD:
STORY: [Corrected story text for this page. Simple, concrete language. One or two sentences.]
ODD_TEXT: [Single keyword or short phrase for the odd slide—the main concept or object]
SALIENT_FEATURES: [2–4 salient features: shape, color, texture, movement, or other visually distinctive qualities. Comma-separated.]
IMAGE_PROMPT: [Short prompt for an AI image generator: high contrast, uncluttered, single main subject.]

[Repeat SPREAD / STORY / ODD_TEXT / SALIENT_FEATURES / IMAGE_PROMPT once per page, in the same order as the pages below. If a page has little or no readable text, still emit a SPREAD with the best reading you can.]

You are helping create CVI-appropriate story books for children with cortical visual impairment. Output your response using EXACTLY these tags. Do not add any other formatting or commentary.

TITLE: [Book title]

ECC_AREA: [ECC area focus, e.g., Compensatory Access, Self-Determination]

ACTIVITY_PROMPT: [One-sentence sensory activity suggestion, e.g., Create a feely box with a ball and a dog toy.]

SPREAD:
STORY: [Story text for the even page. Simple, concrete language. One or two sentences per spread.]
ODD_TEXT: [Single keyword or short phrase for the odd slide—the main concept or object]
SALIENT_FEATURES: [2–4 salient features: shape, color, texture, movement, or other visually distinctive qualities. Comma-separated.]
IMAGE_PROMPT: [Short prompt for an AI image generator: describe one clear, simple image for this spread. CVI-friendly: high contrast, uncluttered, single main subject. Example: A single red ball on plain white background, soft lighting.]

SPREAD:
STORY: [Next spread's story text.]
ODD_TEXT: [Keyword for this spread.]
SALIENT_FEATURES: [Salient features for this spread.]
IMAGE_PROMPT: [AI image generator prompt for this spread.]

[Repeat SPREAD / STORY / ODD_TEXT / SALIENT_FEATURES / IMAGE_PROMPT for each spread.]
